title: The record every monster is given
summary: Every monster in R.E.P.O. is wrapped in a record of its own: a name and a localized version of it, a difficulty, an action multiplier and an overcharge multiplier, an object that switches it on, a range of time it stays spawned for and another it stays away for, and a timer for each.
body: A monster is not only its body. Each one carries a record that describes it, which is how the game can tell one kind of enemy from another without reading the creature's own behaviour.
It has a name. There is a name and a localized version of it, so what a monster is called can be shown in the player's own language rather than only in the files.
It has a difficulty. That value belongs to the record rather than to the level, which is why the same creature can be presented as a harder or easier proposition depending on how it is set up.
It carries multipliers. There is an action multiplier and an overcharge multiplier, which is how one monster can act more often or build up faster than another without a new behaviour being written.
It has a way of being switched on. There is an object used to enable the monster, so whether it is present is a switch rather than a matter of the level being rebuilt.

It has two ranges of time. One covers how long it is spawned for and another how long it is despawned for, each with a lowest and a highest value, so a monster's presence is decided between bounds rather than at one fixed interval.
And it keeps a timer for each of those, so the record knows where it currently is in whichever period it is in rather than only what the bounds are.
What this entry does not tell you: what the multiplier values are, how difficult any monster is rated, or how long either period lasts. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: A monster's record carries a name and a localized version of it.
It carries an action multiplier and an overcharge multiplier.
It has an object used to enable the monster.
It has a spawned time range and a despawned time range, each with a lowest and a highest value.
It keeps a spawned timer and a despawned timer.
